# testdata's sized-number fixtures, on the targets whose arithmetic is not
# Go's: JavaScript holds an int as a double and Kotlin widens Byte and Short
# arithmetic to Int, so each narrows a result back to its width -- a compound
# assignment as well as a binary expression.

mkdir compound conversions float basics wraparound uint
cp $SNGL_ROOT/testdata/test_sized_compound_assign.sngl compound
cp $SNGL_ROOT/testdata/test_sized_conversions.sngl conversions
cp $SNGL_ROOT/testdata/test_sized_float.sngl float
cp $SNGL_ROOT/testdata/test_sized_int_basics.sngl basics
cp $SNGL_ROOT/testdata/test_sized_int_wraparound.sngl wraparound
cp $SNGL_ROOT/testdata/test_sized_uint.sngl uint

sngl test --platform=html ./...
stdout '^ok +22 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin ./...
stdout '^ok +22 tests, 0 failures$'
